question: An amount of ₹976 is divided among three persons in the ratio of 2 : 11 : 17. The difference between the largest and the smallest shares (in ₹) in the distribution is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total parts in the ratio = 2 + 11 + 17 = 30 parts

Difference between largest (17) and smallest (2) parts = 17 − 2 = 15 parts

Since 15 parts is exactly half of the total 30 parts, the required difference is half the total amount.

Difference = 976 ÷ 2 = ₹488

**∴ The correct answer is ₹488.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Amount = ₹976

Ratio of distribution = 2 : 11 : 17

**Formula Used:**

Share = (Ratio part ÷ Sum of all ratio parts) × Total Amount
